title: A gym delete request is sent through the AI help box, with the gym's name, code, phone and the asker's name
what: Tapping Send delete request posts the request as an ordinary help question. The help box saves it and then asks the AI for an answer, so the gym name, gym code, gym phone and the person's name go to the AI company, although the help box promises it never sends the gym code. The request and the AI's reply also land in the owner's Your questions list like any how-to question, and it shares the 20-a-day message limit.
expected: A delete request goes straight to MettleUp's delete list without an AI answer, sends nothing to the AI company, and is not mixed into the help questions.
fix_line: Send delete requests to their own box that skips the AI answer and the question history

title: Help says gym alerts work only while the admin app is open, but they now come with it closed
what: The Needs you help article ends with: alerts work while the admin app is open in a tab. The admin app now sends alerts to the phone or computer with the app closed, and the owner can pick Instantly, Once a day or Once a week in Settings. Help never mentions the closed-app alerts or the timing choice, so an owner may keep a tab open all day for nothing, or not know why alerts come once a day.
expected: The help article says alerts also come with the app closed and explains where to pick when they come.
fix_line: Rewrite the alerts help to cover closed-app alerts and the timing choice

title: When a plan ends and the gym goes read-only, the line on Today gives no way to reach MettleUp
what: The stopped-paying line (hidden for now) says nothing can be changed and offers only Pay now to the owner; desk staff are told to ask the owner. Unlike the paused-gym message, it gives no MettleUp email. The support line meant for every such place is used only on the first sign-in screen.
expected: The read-only and basic-mode lines show the MettleUp support email, like the paused-gym message does.
who: owners and desk staff of a lapsed gym
how_often: once the plan gate is switched on
fix_line: Add the support email line under the read-only and basic-mode messages

title: Help never explains checking a member's workout code, and says the desk gives the reward days
what: The workout offer help article covers starting an offer and says the front desk gives the days members earned. It never mentions Check workout code, the step where the desk types the member's code and sees how many workouts match a check-in. On that screen only the owner can give the days; the desk is told to ask the owner.
expected: Help explains the workout code check and says who can give the reward.
fix_line: Add the workout code check to the workout offer help and fix who gives the days
